t.E160c.agn: In 2015 EFSA set the ADI at 24 mg/kg body weight; intakes remained below this limit.
t.E160c.body: The colouring substances in paprika extract (capsanthin, capsorubin) are poorly absorbed.
t.E160c.prod: Obtained from red pepper by solvent extraction.
t.E160c.regx.0: ADI 24 mg/kg; intakes below the limit.
t.E160c.summary: Red pepper (paprika) extract; gives a red-orange colour and a mild flavour. Used in sucuk, sauces and crisps.
t.E160c.what: Gives a red-orange colour and a mild flavour.
